pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

2. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.

3. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.

4. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.

5. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

6. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.

7. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.

8. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. blue
   C. happiness
   D. run

9. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language School.

10. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only an action

11. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

12. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — One main idea with supporting sentences

2. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.

4. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.

5. D — Where is the library?

6. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.

7. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

8. D — run

9. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.

10. B — A person, place, thing, or idea

11. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

12. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Attentive listening; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language Welcome and; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language School; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
